orgDesign.companyProfile: Proposed operating model for a POM-informed SaaS domain, not a current POM organization chart. Eight teams, role-specific capacity and lightweight group leadership; external bank, messaging, agency and support organizations are outside these staff counts.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Teams own outcomes end to end, with one primary owner per brick. Product teams retain service responsibility; shared reliability and trust teams provide controlled common services. Commercial contract and jurisdiction decisions require creditor and appropriate specialist review. No AI agent is modeled as staff or an autonomous payer decision-maker.
